ok.en: That old lion stayed [[elusive:elusive]], so nobody took a photo of it.
ok.zh: 那头老狮子难得一见，所以没人拍到它的照片。
ok.m: adj. 难以捉摸的；难得一见的
ok.ex: The fox is elusive and comes only at night.
ok.exZh: 狐狸行踪诡秘，只在夜里出来。

ok.en: The teacher showed us a tiny [[mite:mite]] under the glass.
ok.zh: 老师把一只很小的螨放在玻璃片下面给我们看。
ok.ex: Dust mites live in warm house dust.
ok.exZh: 尘螨生活在温暖的室内灰尘里。

ok.en: These small frogs seem [[ubiquitous:ubiquitous]] near water all through spring.
ok.zh: 整个春天，这些小青蛙在水边好像无处不在。
ok.m: adj. 无处不在的；普遍存在的
ok.ex: Phones are now ubiquitous in our school.
ok.exZh: 手机在我们学校里已经无处不在。

ok.en: Sam hung his own [[artwork:artwork]] beside the classroom door for the show.
ok.zh: 萨姆把自己的艺术作品挂在教室门边，等着那次展览。
ok.ex: Our teacher chose one artwork for the wall.
ok.exZh: 我们老师挑了一件作品挂在墙上。

ok.en: Every morning, Lin packs his [[backpack:backpack]] with lunch and one red book.
ok.zh: 每天早晨，林都把午餐和一本红皮书装进双肩背包。
ok.ex: Her backpack is too heavy to carry.
ok.exZh: 她的书包太重，拎不动。

ok.en: Mingming and Uncle Wang [[refurbish:refurbished]] an old chair with fresh paint.
ok.zh: 明明和王叔叔用新漆翻修了一把旧椅子。
ok.ex: They refurbish old bikes and sell them cheap.
ok.exZh: 他们翻修旧自行车，再便宜地卖掉。

ok.en: Mingming tied his red [[trainer:trainers]] and ran down to the shop.
ok.zh: 明明系好红色运动鞋，一路跑到了小店。
ok.ex: Wear old trainers for the long walk.
ok.exZh: 走远路时要穿旧的运动鞋。

ok.en: The tired shop owner swept the [[footpath:footpath]] clean before the first bus.
ok.zh: 第一班公交车来之前，疲惫的店主就把人行道扫干净了。
ok.ex: Two bikes blocked the narrow footpath.
ok.exZh: 两辆自行车挡住了狭窄的人行道。

ok.en: The whole town agreed on fairer [[governance:governance]] under shared rules.
ok.zh: 全城人在共同遵守的规则下，商定了一套更公平的治理方式。
ok.ex: The company changed its governance after the loss.
ok.exZh: 那家公司亏损之后改变了自身的治理方式。

ok.en: One loud fight at the market gave the corner sudden [[notoriety:notoriety]].
ok.zh: 市场里的一场吵骂，让这处街角突然臭名远扬。
ok.ex: The writer gained notoriety after one rude letter.
ok.exZh: 那位作家因一封无礼的信而恶名远扬。

ok.en: The rich guest smiled with a cold air of [[superiority:superiority]].
ok.zh: 那位富有的客人微微一笑，却带着一股冷漠的优越感。
ok.ex: Nobody enjoyed his air of superiority.
ok.exZh: 没人喜欢他那种优越感。

ok.en: No one accepted the [[supremacy:supremacy]] of one old family over the rest.
ok.zh: 没人接受一个老牌家族凌驾于众人之上的霸权地位。
ok.ex: The two cities fought for supremacy in trade.
ok.exZh: 这两座城市为贸易霸权而争斗。

ok.en: Our street now has a new [[surveillance:surveillance]] camera above the gate.
ok.zh: 我们这条街的大门上方，现在安了一个监控摄像头。
ok.ex: The shop uses surveillance cameras at night.
ok.exZh: 那家小店夜里开着监控摄像头。

ok.en: The town built an exact [[replica:replica]] of the old gate in the square.
ok.zh: 镇上在广场里建了一座旧城门的等比例复制品。
ok.ex: Museum visitors bought a replica of the lamp.
ok.exZh: 博物馆的参观者买了那盏灯的复制品。

ok.en: Anna learned to rest when a mild [[ailment:ailment]] made her eyes water.
ok.zh: 每当轻微的不适让眼睛发酸，安娜就学会停下来休息。
ok.ex: A mild ailment made her eyes water.
ok.exZh: 轻微的不适让她眼睛发酸。

ok.en: When his [[asthma:asthma]] came back, Chen sat up by the open window.
ok.zh: 哮喘一复发，陈就坐起身，靠在敞开的窗边。
ok.ex: His asthma gets worse in cold air.
ok.exZh: 冷空气会让他的哮喘加重。

ok.en: Grandma boiled her water because [[cholera:cholera]] once spread in her village.
ok.zh: 奶奶把水烧开了，因为霍乱曾在她们村里传播。
ok.ex: Cholera often spreads through dirty water.
ok.exZh: 霍乱常经脏水传播。

ok.en: At the ward door, visitors washed their hands twice to stop [[ebola:ebola]].
ok.zh: 在病房门口，探视的人把手洗了两遍，以防埃博拉扩散。
ok.m: n. 埃博拉热；埃博拉病毒
ok.ex: The nurses feared the spread of Ebola.
ok.exZh: 护士们害怕埃博拉的传播。

ok.en: Sleep and warm food help a tired body build stronger [[immunity:immunity]].
ok.zh: 睡眠和温热的食物能帮疲惫的身体建立起更强的免疫力。
ok.ex: Good sleep helps build your immunity.
ok.exZh: 好的睡眠有助于增强免疫力。

ok.en: During the [[pandemic:pandemic]], children took their lessons at the kitchen table.
ok.zh: 大流行期间，孩子们就在厨房的桌子上上课。
ok.ex: The pandemic changed how we work.
ok.exZh: 这场大流行改变了我们的工作方式。

ok.en: The old nurse called her sore throat and fever a strange [[syndrome:syndrome]].
ok.zh: 那位年长的护士把她喉咙痛又发烧称作一种奇怪的综合征。
ok.ex: Doctors named this syndrome only last year.
ok.exZh: 医生们去年才为这种综合征命名。

ok.en: Doctors sent her to the hills to cure the [[tuberculosis:tuberculosis]] with fresh air.
ok.zh: 医生把她送到山里，想靠新鲜空气治好她的肺结核。
ok.ex: Tuberculosis once kept her in bed for a year.
ok.exZh: 结核病曾让她卧床一年。

ok.en: The small clinic gave Mei one quick [[vaccination:vaccination]] before lunch.
ok.zh: 那家小诊所赶在午饭前给梅接种了疫苗。
ok.m: n. 疫苗接种；预防注射
ok.ex: The vaccination took only one minute.
ok.exZh: 这次疫苗接种只花了一分钟。
